artDirection.enemyHeadwear: varied scarves/head coverings as fictional visual styling

integrationRules: Gameplay code must not depend on art dimensions.
Keep collision boxes separate from sprite bounds.
Use an asset registry instead of hard-coded paths throughout gameplay systems.
Preserve portrait mobile framing and forward camera visibility.
The Temple Mount / Old City skyline is a distant parallax landmark, not collision geometry.
Remove labels/borders from source sheets when producing transparent runtime sprites.
Do not redesign approved characters, colors, clothing, UI, or environment without approval.
